```artifact
Feature: Database and System Design

  Scenario: Database Capacity
    Given a database with a capacity of 3 years
    When the database receives 4.0 Million Consultation requests
    Then the database should handle the requests without failure

  Scenario: Unique Patients
    Given the system is designed to cater to 250,000 unique Patients
    When the system provisions these patients
    Then the system should support all 250,000 unique Patients without issues

  Scenario: Specialities Support
    Given the system is designed to support up to 5 specialities
    When the system is used for 5 specialities
    Then the system should handle all 5 specialities without issues

  Scenario: Future Growth
    Given the system is designed with future growth in mind
    When the system is used for a period beyond 3 years
    Then the system should continue to handle requests without issues

  Scenario: Mobile Platform Support
    Given the system is designed to run on a mobile platform (Android)
    When the system is accessed from an Android device
    Then the system should be accessible and functional on the Android device

  Scenario: Adaptive User Interfaces
    Given the system is designed with adaptive user interfaces in mind
    When the system is accessed from different devices
    Then the system should adapt to the device's screen size and orientation

  Scenario: Usability Perspective
    Given the system is designed with usability in mind
    When the system is used by a user
    Then the system should be easy to use with appropriate font sizes and intuitive navigation
```
